summary: AST SpaceMobile filed an 8-K announcing a proposed offering of convertible senior notes due 2034 to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, along with an intention to enter into capped call transactions. The filing also disclosed preliminary unaudited cash and cash equivalents of approximately $2,723 million as of June 30, 2026, and an update on BlueBird satellite launch timing targeting approximately 45 satellites in early 2027. No specific deal terms such as price per share or premium were provided in this excerpt. This is a capital markets activity, not a special situation.
